ustrChina.publisher: Office of the United States Trade Representative

ustrIndia.publisher: Office of the United States Trade Representative

creaSep2026.publisher: Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air

indiaPower.publisher: India Ministry of Power, Lok Sabha written answer

observations.limitation: USTR estimated US import valuation; not Chinese net exports, welfare, tariff effect or a bilateral trade agreement outcome.
observations.costGap: Tariff incidence, landed costs and consumers' substitution spending unavailable.
observations.counterfactualGap: Demand, third-country rerouting and tariff changes not controlled.

observations.limitation: US exports and imports are distinct directions; services excluded.
observations.costGap: Producer margins and forgone export profits not measured.
observations.counterfactualGap: Exchange rates, demand and controls on exports not isolated.

observations.comparison: US services exports 42.9bn; imports 47.6bn; USTR rounded totals
observations.limitation: USTR estimated services trade; separate from goods trade in previous batch; rounded components sum to USD 90.5bn against USD 90.4bn reported total.
observations.costGap: Services sector margins and net national welfare unavailable.
observations.counterfactualGap: Services demand and classification shifts not controlled.

observations.metric: EU imported energy products gross trade value
observations.comparison: Eurostat release states -11.1% vs 2024; cross-vintage revisions possible
observations.limitation: All imported energy products, not only gas or Russia; nominal invoice value not EU net welfare. Prior 2024 release cited EUR 375.9bn; simple division gives a different rate, so do not cross-vintage recompute.
observations.costGap: Actual trade spending is measured; substitution premium and household incidence are not.
observations.counterfactualGap: Commodity price, demand and energy mix confound geopolitical effects.

observations.metric: EU imported energy products net mass
observations.comparison: Eurostat release states -0.6% vs 2024; cross-vintage revisions possible
observations.limitation: Aggregate mass across fuels is not energy-equivalent volume. Prior 2024 release cited 720.4 Mt, incompatible with stated -0.6% without revisions; don't splice vintages.
observations.costGap: Tonnes do not reveal import unit prices or consumer cost.
observations.counterfactualGap: Demand and product composition change; no same-fuel substitution inference.

observations.metric: Reported US and Russian supplier shares of EU imported LNG
observations.limitation: Article does not explicitly define whether origin shares use value or mass; do not infer tonnes, revenue, or one-for-one replacement.
observations.costGap: Delivered price, regas costs, taxes and LNG contract premiums not measured.
observations.counterfactualGap: Country origin share not causal attribution to sanctions.

observations.metric: European Commission Ukraine Facility tranche released
observations.comparison: Includes EUR 0.8bn Ukraine Support Loan component; eighth Facility payment
observations.limitation: Payer-confirmed release, not recipient-side bank reconciliation; EUR 0.8bn is included, not additional; separate from 2025 ERA loans.
observations.costGap: Loan repayment and downstream budget incidence not established.
observations.counterfactualGap: Reform conditionality documented, but no causal claim that cash changed geopolitical alignment.

observations.metric: Actual solar electricity generation in China
observations.limitation: Independent generation estimate; electricity output, not installed capacity or exports. Ember methodology differs from Chinese NEA capacity series.
observations.costGap: Grid integration, curtailment and investment cost not linked to this generation figure.
observations.counterfactualGap: No quantified coal/gas counterfactual by province.

observations.metric: Growth in Chinese wind electricity generation
observations.limitation: Annual additional output, not total generation or capacity additions; not additive to clean-generation growth without checking components.
observations.costGap: Wind investment and curtailment costs unmeasured.
observations.counterfactualGap: Weather variability and grid constraints not controlled.

observations.metric: Change in Chinese fossil electricity generation
observations.limitation: Signed change is negative by design; coal and gas are components, not separate additive claims.
observations.costGap: Fuel costs and plant fixed costs not observed.
observations.counterfactualGap: Cannot attribute all fossil reduction to solar/wind; demand and hydro/nuclear confound.

observations.metric: CREA-estimated Russian fossil-fuel export gross revenue per day
observations.comparison: Broadly unchanged month-on-month while physical export volumes fell 6%
observations.limitation: Independent CREA model, not audited cash receipts or Russian fiscal revenues; gross all-fuel revenue includes LNG and crude subsets.
observations.costGap: Production costs, shipping discounts, taxes and profits not measured.
observations.counterfactualGap: Global prices, demand and rerouting prevent sanctions-only causal inference.

observations.metric: CREA-estimated Russian LNG unloaded-cargo export gross revenue per day
observations.limitation: Subset of Russia total fossil exports; cargo-unloading basis, not loading-month receipts. Never add to EUR625m/day total.
observations.costGap: Liquefaction, shipping, sanctions-compliance and netback costs unmeasured.
observations.counterfactualGap: LNG seasonality, prices and Arctic LNG 2 loadings confound policy attribution.

observations.metric: Share of Russian seaborne oil transported by sanctioned shadow tankers
observations.comparison: Additional 40% by G7+ owned or insured tankers; rest other shadow vessels
observations.limitation: CREA vessel classification and modeled trade flows, not verified evasion count or proof of legal breach.
observations.costGap: Insurance, financing and freight premiums not independently priced.
observations.counterfactualGap: Need vessel-level pre/post controls to isolate sanction effects.

observations.metric: India solar installed generation capacity added during FY2025-26 through January
observations.comparison: Indian Ministry of Power Lok Sabha reply; FY-to-date not calendar 2025
observations.limitation: Official installed generation capacity additions, not electricity actually generated, project-level cash spending, or a full FY result.
observations.costGap: Installation cost, subsidy paid and grid balancing expenses unavailable.
observations.counterfactualGap: No matched comparison to no-policy scenario; do not compare directly with calendar-year Ember additions.

observations.metric: Growth in Indian renewable electricity generation
observations.comparison: Solar +53 TWh, wind +22 TWh, hydro +21 TWh; demand +49 TWh
observations.limitation: Independent Ember analysis; subcomponents overlap total. Weather drove hydro output and reduced cooling demand; not all growth is policy-caused.
observations.costGap: Generation costs, subsidy payments and consumer bills not estimated.
observations.counterfactualGap: Mild 2025 temperatures and demand slowdown require weather-normalized counterfactual.

nonAdditivity: Russia LNG export revenue is part of total Russian fossil export revenue, not an additional receipt.
EU LNG supplier shares are fractions of the same import market and cannot be added to energy import EUR/tonne totals.
China solar/wind growth contributes to total clean generation; fossil decline is a different outcome, not a sum.
India solar capacity additions FY-to-Jan and Ember calendar-year renewable generation measure different things.
USTR goods flows and services flows have different scopes; USTR reported services rounded components may differ from reported total by USD 0.1bn.
EU 2025 energy imports: compare only within the Eurostat 2026 release vintage; the earlier 2024 release contains a different historical mass/value baseline.
EU October 2026 EUR0.8bn Support Loan is contained within EUR2.9bn tranche, not additive.
Prior SOI 15-observation batch includes US-India goods trade, EU ERA 2025 loans and 2025 China-Laos/Whoosh figures; none are re-counted here.
remainingGates: Recipient-side confirmation of EU cash disbursement and project-level spending
Independent cross-source validation for USTR/Eurostat/India government aggregates where available
Matched geography, time, product definitions and price/volume decompositions
Project-level costs, margins and domestic consumer incidence
Credible policy counterfactuals before assigning any influence score
